description: Defines max(a, int b) where the first parameter has no type.
injected_faults: line 3: parameter 'a' has no type in 'int max(a, int b)'
notes: The found token is the identifier 'a' where a type was expected. The later call max(...) may or may not be reported as undeclared, depending on recovery; only the syntax error is expected as a root. gcc is more lenient (K&R style) but rejects this mixed form.
